data.rationale: The proposal follows the same procedure in the same order (timeanddate, then weather.com 10-day forecast, then an email to family@example.com with the matching subject and body), but it hardcodes "Lille", makes the recipient a parameter when it is fixed, omits the final "don't send, click Discard" step, and expects details like high/low and rain chance that the true body template doesn't clearly include. So a builder would have to guess some details.
